title: Ngan'gi language - Wikipedia
text: Ngan'gi, formerly known as Ngan'gityemerri, and also known as Ngan'gikurunggurr, Moil/Moyle, Tyemeri/Tyemerri, Marityemeri, and Nordaniman, is an Australian Aboriginal language spoken in the Daly River region of Australiaʼs Northern Territory.

title: Ngan’gityemerri Language (NAM)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Ngan’gityemerri is an endangered indigenous language of Australia. It belongs to the Australian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by adults only. It is not known to be taught in schools.
